sentences.text: This shortfin mako was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Shortfin makos are among the fastest-swimming sharks.
On {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began, {species_rank_distance}.
Its positions span from {southernmost_lat} to {northernmost_lat}, with one silence of {longest_gap_days}.
